notes.title: Pandemic Train update! Voice-overs, and 2 new languages
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome survivors![/h2]

We're thrilled to announce a fresh update for Pandemic Train, packed with fantastic additions to enhance your gaming experience. In response to the enthusiastic feedback from our global community, we've incorporated [b]two new languages[/b] into the game: Ukrainian and Italian! Now, players can dive into the thrilling world of Pandemic Train in even more linguistic flavors.

But that's not all! We've also introduced [b]voice-over[/b] support in English, bringing an extra layer of immersion to your gameplay. Whether you're strategizing your next move or unraveling the mysteries of the pandemic, let the captivating voices guide you through the journey.

And now you can buy a ticket for this train [b]25% discounted[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/97eab2dee35cd0355bfd8142d36fdb3c0b86709a.png[/img]

[h3]What next?[/h3]

But hold on tight, because there's more excitement on the horizon! [b]Brace yourselves for a massive upcoming update[/b], set to revolutionize your Pandemic Train adventure. 


All aboard for adventure and excitement – Pandemic Train is rolling into new territories, and we invite you to join us on this thrilling ride! 


[expand type=details]
[list]
[*] Adding English Voice-Overs
[*] Adding Italian language
[*] Adding the Ukrainian language
[*] Fixing minor bugs
[/list]
[/expand]

notes.title: We're announcing first two station of our Roadmap!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Survivors! [/h2]

We are excited to share [b]our plans for the evolution of Pandemic Train[/b]. Get ready for an enhanced exploration experience, a more immersive world, and addictive gameplay improvements!

[h2]1) Exploration events and side missions:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Dynamic Events[/b]: We plan to add events to the game that occur during the exploration phase of specific areas. 
[*] [b]Side missions from NPCs[/b]: We want our non-playable characters to offer one-time missions to complete 
[*] [b]World-building[/b]: We will create new map locations with intriguing facts about our post-apocalyptic world.
[*] [b]Improved leader missions[/b]: Leader missions will be revamped to provide a more immersive and rewarding experience.
[/list]

[h2]2) Improved train experience:[/h2]

[olist]
[*] [b]Passenger Dynamics[/b]: Your train will be able to host additional passengers, each with unique goals like getting to a certain destination.
[*] [b]Passenger interaction[/b]: You will have the choice to remain neutral or use the passengers for your benefit, adding a moral dimension to your decisions.
[*] [b]Train and exploration[/b]: We'd like to make the exploration and train phases more influential on each other
[/olist]

[b]Each of these first two stations of our roadmap will require a couple of months of development. [/b]Therefore, we're not giving you any specific dates yet, but you can be sure we're already working on the first part.

[h2]Join us in shaping the future of Pandemic Train![/h2]
[url=https://discord.gg/2sertJYnAy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/268ee106eae09799125e69236b16484df11be9f4.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/TriggerLabsGames/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/757c90d4ac88340bccee6aedc7a31bacbe6876cb.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/triggerlabspl][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/fadc7348d8e7c6bea0632977b68af88a306b81ac.png[/img][/url]

We are working hard to make Pandemic Train an even more exciting and immersive experience. Stay tuned for our announcements as we work tirelessly to bring these exciting changes to life.

[h2]Stay on track to survive the travel on our Pandemic Train![/h2]
Pandemic Train team

notes.title: Hot-fix 1.1.1
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Survivors,[/h2]

It's been a month since the Pandemic Train was released. [b]Thanks to all of you who played[/b]. We truly hope you enjoyed the game even a little bit. 
We're doing our best to improve the game toward your expectations, even if you report something easy to fix during the weekend. Therefore, we have a little hot fix for you today!

[h2]What does the fix say?[/h2]
[list]This hotfix contains a fix for the following two bugs reported by you as strongly influencing the experience of playing Pandemic Train after the last update: 

[*] When the previous update launched, players who had unfinished runs could not buy any new modules.
[*] Leaders, despite having purchased the "expert" profession upgrade, did not have this upgrade after leaving HQ by train.[/list]

[h2]What's coming?[/h2]
Keep an eye on Pandemic Train, because we're getting closer to letting you in on a secret or two about the roadmap for the game's future. What would you like to get the most? 

Remember to stay on the right track and keep your train going!

notes.title: Pandemic Train - Game's Update 1.1!
notes.content:
[h2]Attention, Survivors![/h2]

We're thrilled to announce the arrival of the first update for Pandemic Train, packed with exciting new features and improvements to enhance your gaming experience. Here's what you can expect:

[h3]New Salesman Kulson:[/h3]
Meet Kulson, a new vendor who will appear in locations different than those with the Bone Collector. Kulson offers unique goods and items to help you on your Pandemic Train adventure. Be ready for exciting new offerings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/03e07b13fc1e08591f469ecb1dc3453f3642eb52.png[/img]

[h3]Travel Innovation - "Jump" to selected locations:[/h3]
Harness the power of metacurrency to leap to your chosen destination! With the latest update, Kovalsky's happy to smuggle you and your crew, enabling strategic movements from HQ across the map… if only you have some extra metacurrency to offer him in exchange. Plan your routes wisely and stay one step ahead of the pandemic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/bc0ae12e4c93e8e2436e39aa9944be2b5945177e.png[/img]

[h3]Persistent Train Modules:[/h3]
Your train is now more resilient than ever! After facing the challenges of the pandemic head-on, your train's modules will remain intact upon your return to headquarters or even after unfortunate incidents resulting in the loss of a life. Keep building and fortifying your train for the ultimate pandemic survival.

[h3]Module Schematics Remain After Death:[/h3]
Fear not, engineers! In the face of adversity, your hard-earned module schematics will persist even in the event of death. Your knowledge and progress are not lost, ensuring a more rewarding and strategic gameplay experience.

Get ready to dive back into the world of Pandemic Train with these awaited by you features! We appreciate your dedication to the game and hope these enhancements add a new layer of excitement to your railroading adventures.

More changes and improvements made can be found in the changelog:

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[expand type=details]
[list]
[b]Added:[/b]

[*] - After death or returning to HQ, modules built on the train remain.
[*] - After death, schematics of modules purchased remain, including when returning to Headquarters and completing a Run.
[*] - We added the ability to "jump" to a location of your choice for a metavalue (after reaching a minimum of the third location).
[*] - We added a new salesman - Kulson on maps without Bone Collector
[*] - We added the possibility to skip the tutorial on the train
[*] - We added a button to change the camera angle on the train

[b]Changed:[/b]
[*] - We improved the Balance related to the mechanics update

[b]Fixed:[/b]
[*] - Fixed dialog display for 21:9 and 16:10 screens 
[*] - Fixed a reported bug of snipers not firing a bullet on the first shot
 
[/list]
[/expand]

Stay vigilant, stay strategic, and keep the pandemic at bay!

The Pandemic Train Development Team

 https://store.steampowered.com/app/1379600/Pandemic_Train/

notes.title: Hot-Fix 1.0.4 - Fixes and another Gameplay!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Survivors! [/h2]
Today, another dose of fixes for Pandemic Train! 

First, though, we want to show you some more gameplay. This time, the video comes from [b]Yippee Ki Yay Mr. Falcon[/b], who played both of our early demos! 

So let's watch the video and check out his impressions after the release! Grab a warm cup of tea, cover yourself with a blanket, and enjoy the show!

[previewyoutube=GVewMgxK6E0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h2]Changelog[/h2][/b]
[expand type=details]
[list]
[*] Mevlit has a starting improvement of an additional slot for special items, as described in the Codex.
[*] Bullets shot at you by the enemies won't try to miss the explosive barrels.
[*]You should now see all the tutorial dialogues properly (there was a problem with the first dialogue not appearing to some of the players).
[*] Missing VO for the 1st boss you meet on the 4th run is no longer missing 🙂
[*] If you find a lot of items during exploration with autofight, they will no longer stick out of the box.
[*] Buying alcohol from Olgierd will now unlock a proper description in the Codex and show the alcohol in players' inventory. It will also fix your HP if you assign it to one of your crew members.
[*] Ela shall always have something to say, therefore, her "..." line was deleted from her dialogue.
[*] Your enemies won't run in fear and shock anymore when they see your leaders swap places in the battlefield.

[/list]
[/expand]

Until the next one!
Pandemic Train Team

notes.title: Special abilities of enemies, Infection and Auto-exploration
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome survivors![/h2]

There are [b]5 days left until the release! [/b]

Continuing the theme of the last devlog, you will again read about the combat phase of Pandemic Train. Today, however, we won't write about our leaders or how to help yourself in battle. 

[b]Today will be about our enemies.[/b]

[h3]Special abilities of enemies[/h3]
Just as each leader has their own unique abilities, the enemies are also different. Today we will talk about three enemies who have abilities that differ from the rest of the group.

[list]
[*] Leap
[/list]
Otterbear jumps great distances, causing a powerful impact at the landing site.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/b759105187bf6d93e836e7813782123c7d1b686a.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Ambush
[/list]
Attack by surprise in the hope of infecting the target before it escapes. Watch where you step.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/1fbaf586c6751c86ec902a43dd786bf6479a609e.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Snipers
[/list]
Skilled Asesina who aim from a long distance. Even though you can't see them, don't stay in one place when you notice them targeting you. They don't miss... Take cover or dodge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/abe7add6d883f6b5ef7d0ea1745c3962ed907941.gif[/img]


[h3]Infection[/h3]
Still an enemy, but no longer as easy to defeat as the previous three. The infection in Pandemic Train has changed its in-game action a little. When the infection bar reaches its limit, the infection will start to take over the leader's life bar, limiting their maximum life in exploration as well as on the train.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/bd6523708025c9fd9b0a0f76152fa6e7f0208fd8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/e5de22d6653484f6a69e39c7fe4344a8205a4e42.png[/img]

[h3]Auto-exploration[/h3]
However, when it comes to combat, there is a way for you not to have to do this. Your leaders, of course, have to fight a battle and are still at risk, but this happens without your participation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/d0511d764e2a0bef7b23ce053670bc3fe8faa942.png[/img]


To round off today's devlog, we'd like to remind you that there's still a community challenge going on, where you can win[b] up to 15%[/b] off the launch price! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/6b9dd32b647984d8c37e7026f77ad5d3662e0c6a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/44475d8e3d5949d7c39246fa6a7abb2e020bb7bb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/ae72397531521a9ab2780b6c73aa2a62bac62cd6.png[/img]



To make your contribution to our community challenge, all you have to do is follow Steam Community – Pandemic Train and add the game to your wishlist.

[h3]Follow[/h3]
Here's how to sign up for the Steam Community Hub:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/45f8ef2dd88e7600d524f56cc86dc4c8ce2d1c80.gif[/img]

Go to the Pandemic Train page on the Steam store.
Select “Follow” button under the window with the trailer of the game.


[h3]Wishlist[/h3]
However, the number of additions to the wishlist also counts, so click below to get Pandemic Train on your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1379600/Pandemic_Train/

Until the next one!

notes.title: Lets talk Pandemic Train: Food & liquors
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome survivors![/h2]

Today we're going to show you a two of upgrades regarding what has changed on Pandemic Train. 

[h3]Food[/h3]
The kitchen on our train has been upgraded. Depending on the skill level of the worker or leader, we have more options to choose the dishes we create. Better dishes also mean more benefits for the eater of such a meal. Tastier food means a happier crew!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/bca78b4e39d4c7f382d970308e20393b8912b522.png[/img]

[h3]Specialty drinks[/h3]
Like the kitchen, the bar has also received new features. Among the liquors served in our private train bar are new “drinks”. However, in order to be able to drink them in it, we have to produce them, of course.  Distillery is the module where we will produce these liquors, but as you may have already guessed… Not everyone is able to create a drink that exhibits special properties when consumed. So, just as with the kitchen, in the distillery we need a person trained in this subject.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/011f98a2e8193ecb872bb53128fb6ec9d364ae93.png[/img]

Until the next one!

notes.title: Lets talk Pandemic Train: The map and checkpoints
notes.content:
[h2]Hello survivors! [/h2]
As you probably already know very well, we take your comments and feedbacks to heart. So today we bring you information about two things that were suggested to us by you. 

[h3]Map[/h3]
The map on which we make choices about the train route has been improved. On the left there is a legend explaining the markings. And when we click on the location we want to go to, we see icons telling us what awaits us in that location. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/f0a998c492b1e6ecb10f8b4302134d054d50edd4.png[/img]

[h3]Checkpoints[/h3]
When your mission does not go as planned and the leaders die and all seems lost.... with new hope come checkpoints, which give us a second chance to carry out our mission to save humanity better, and hopefully with success. They are distributed in several places in each act of the game. Whether you take advantage of this solution, however, is up to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/492242ff060676b348a0f6d49910acf75fb1511b.png[/img]

As Henry Ford said: "The only real mistake is the one from which we learn nothing".

See you next week!

notes.title: Lets talk Pandemic Train: Items useful in combat
notes.content:
[h2]Hello survivors! [/h2]

We've already written a lot about managing, upgrading and making items on the train. Today there won't be many words, but instead you'll see how the new items we can use in fighting will work! 

Let's start with two items that are also special items. Just place one of them in the leader's inventory and his shots will gain special abilities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/f1b1d5589faddd0f47c77bf63c0fa93521b3c710.png[/img]

[h3]Piercing bullets[/h3]
Bullets that will not stop at the first enemy they hit. They will pierce him and anyone who stands in their way! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/6700b3aa5f95450ad862eacd45bf7fb2c5471873.gif[/img]

[h3]Explosive bullets[/h3]
Projectiles that explode when an enemy is hit and deal [b]damage to nearby enemies.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/ec1ee54cefaad9ff2774ab32c88517eab1d23dfc.gif[/img]

[h3]Stun grenade[/h3]
The last of the items we will present to you today is the stinker. As the name suggests, it does not smell the best. When exploded, the grenade spreads a cloud of stinky gas that makes enemies unable to move.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/1e364dba120396b44c27ca37f7822d08ed706448.gif[/img]

[i]Gross...[/i]

[h3]More frequent articles[/h3]
That's the end of Pandemic Train news for today, but we also have some good news for you. From now on, developer diaries will be published more frequently. [b]We will announce articles once a week! [/b]

See you next week, survivors!

notes.title: Lets talk Pandemic Train: Workers and Events
notes.content:
[h2]Hello survivors![/h2]

Let's start by saying [b]thank you[/b] to all the participants of the second beta - [b]Pandemic Train[/b] for taking part in the testing! We are grateful to you for your involvement and all your feedbacks.


[h3]What will you learn about the game today?[/h3] 

Following on from previous Devlogs, today we want to show you what you actually gain from spending meta currencies and upgrades. 
In addition to increased resources to start a new journey or more hp, we can upgrade our train crew.

[b]A trained worker[/b] will have more options when working on the train, giving us a better chance of survival! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/1d838303c10a334206169483bd31146bb0f06895.png[/img]

As you can see in the above screenshot - a trained worker produces [b]more for less! [/b]
To see which profession a crew member is trained in, just hover your cursor over his icon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/2742f7e673a4cf7f1fab465e25ce0378d0183b83.png[/img]

[h3]Events[/h3]

Keeping with the crew theme, we'll also reveal something new to you. While the leaders are fighting outside the train, there is still something happening on the train. When you return from exploring, you may come across a message telling you about some events that happened while you were away. 

These events can be good or bad, and sometimes you will have to act on them. It will be up to you to make a decision. Each decision will have consequences, and some may affect future events. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/64698f3acaf752b50f6b3897c925e11a89b4cc3d.png[/img]

Managing people is not an easy thing to do, and as F.D. Roosevelt used to say:

[i]“It's a terrible thing to look over your shoulder when you are trying to lead -- and to find no one there.”[/i]

Until the next one!

notes.content:
[h2]Welcome survivors!
[/h2]

[h3]Messages for Testers [/h3]

The beta is fast approaching, and there are messages waiting on the emails for selected testers from us, with information about getting into the second beta of Pandemic Train!

Remember to take a look at your spam as well, where our message might have accidentally gone. 

However, before the second beta begins, take a look at how the Headquarters functionality has changed.

[h3]Upgrading leaders[/h3]

While in Headquarters, you can upgrade many of the aspects that are important during gameplay. In the barracks, you can upgrade each leader individually using the Pandemic Train meta currency. For the right amount, you can get upgrades such as more space in the selected leader's backpack or his HP or damage taken.

notes.title: Work in progress – new mechanics that will be in the second beta
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome survivors![/h2]

We have some "work in progress" news for you in Pandemic Train. The new mechanics we are going to show you now will be in the second beta, and you will be able to test them! 

[h3]Resource distribution[/h3]
The first new feature in Pandemic Train is the allocation of resources to the train crew, which has been expanded. The player can make decisions in moments of crisis as to which crew member will not receive vital resources like water, food, or medicine. This also leads us to another new mechanic....

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/936f352b038a349d45131127e1897069b8694492.png[/img]

[h3]Morale and unmet needs[/h3]
Each member of the train's crew has a morale indicator, which means that every time one of them runs out of resources, their morale and health will drop. A crew member whose morale gets down to zero might abandon their post.

[h3]Backpack[/h3]
We have introduced a mechanic into the game that allows the player to decide what utility items he wants to carry with him during exploration and combat. A first aid kit? A crowbar? How about a molotov or other items useful in combat? Or changing the special item assigned to the leader? You can do it all right here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/9a1242aa265389d2995e3828fa1428506a51bbbd.png[/img]

However, we don't promise that these new mechanics will look exactly the same as we present here, as we are still working on making them as enjoyable to play as possible. 

[url=https://forms.gle/n6UCtPdjbAPuLbe67][h3]Sign up for Beta![/h3][/url]

Sign-ups for the second round of testing are still ongoing, so if you want to check out the new mechanics we've added to Pandemic Train, you can still do so!

notes.title: The one about your beta feedback and our solutions
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Survivors,[/h2]
We're back with [b]more information on the beta test feedback and our solutions[/b]. We can't tell you all the secrets, however, we want to spill a little bit on what we're working on.

[h2]Managing the train[/h2]
In beta tests, a lot of you said that [b]managing the train is the best part of the game[/b]. You wanted more time on the train and, what's more important, way more things to do there. So we decided to[b] add some steam to the game (hehe, gotcha!)[/b] and change things a bit. We're still testing different options, but you can be sure that [b]your hero's skill in different fields will affect what and how many resources of each kind can they produce[/b]. 

[h2]Have hope, or else...[/h2]
Your comparisons to many great games like Fallout Shelter or This War of Mine flatter us enormously! We love these productions so much and would love to make something similar that becomes an example to follow. However, with these correlations comes your need for a morale system or moral dilemmas. Therefore, [b]we've introduced the parameter of hope[/b]. 
How will it affect your gameplay though? Well, just you wait... Just you wait! :)  

[h2]Combat and exploration[/h2]
[b]One of your biggest concerns was combat[/b]. You didn't enjoy it, said it's too hard and challenging. There were also some issues regarding aiming. We've analyzed all comments about these aspects and improved fighting at train stations. There is also a bit more happening during exploration, especially in the 2nd biome. Many [b]more kinds of resources lay around, just waiting for you to be taken (with or without spilling your enemy's blood).[/b] 
We're also glad to say that [b]we're working hard on the game's balance[/b] and making the story level a bit easier. 

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
All these things are [b]still just a part of what we're doing[/b]. However, if you want, you can already express your feeling about them in the comments.
Also, [b]we will soon e-mail those of you who sent the best feedback earlier on and ask you to play the newest build of the game[/b]. Check your mailboxes around mid-June.

[h2]Remember, there is always light at the end of every tunnel.[/h2]
Pandemic Train team

notes.title: Let's talk about Pandemic Train: What's new in Pandemic Train?
notes.content:
[h1]Hello survivors![/h1]

We have some news for you in [b]Pandemic Train[/b], which we are happy to present to you. In addition to the already implemented elements, we will also tell you what we are currently working on!

[h2]Contamination zone[/h2]

During the gameplay, you will be able to notice specific areas which are distinguished by an increased level of difficulty. [b]Contamination zones[/b], as they are called, and they are entirely covered by the plague. Here, you won't find a safe place where the blight bar stops filling up. Visibility is also not the best, so be extremely careful about your every step. Don't worry though, because [b]tougher gameplay will be rewarded with bigger and better loot![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/cef49bb66d951699d6f088ca07d84a47c94c3d7a.png[/img]

[h2]Day & night[/h2]

We've added a day and night system that enriches the visual experience while adding variety to the exploration. Night makes combat more difficult, due to lower visibility, especially in biomes one and three, while day brings some light to the swamps of biome two.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/e7684ab912983fc940a5488b7d6e220137dd9d63.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/6543959e142913c2d9627029a9c178b2dfaf0d5d.png[/img]

[h2]Support for controllers[/h2]

For all of you gamers who prefer to sit comfortably in a chair instead of bending over a keyboard, we have some great news for you! We have introduced controller control! 

[h2]What is our current focus?[/h2]
In addition to what we have already described above, we are working on a couple of new features for the travel phase: queuing of tasks, assigning food and water to individual crew members on a whim, a backpack for the player to fill with most useful items before leaving the train, and more.

You can be sure that you will be kept up to date with all the news. In the meantime, let us give you a special sentence for today:

[i]If you don't know where you are going, any road will lead you there.[/i]

Until the next one!

notes.title: Let's Talk about Pandemic Train: Merry Christmas, survivors!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello survivors![/h2]
The winter atmosphere is embracing us more and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/e5ddf1456907f6028176c8812e40643da60822a2.png[/img]

Even in a Pandemic Train, winter has no mercy and freezes the train to extremely low temperatures. 
As Christmas is just around the corner, we've decided to give our crew something to warm them up. After all, what could be better than a heating stove module when you're almost freezing to death, right?


We, on the other hand, wish you to enjoy a wonderful warm Christmas atmosphere with your dearest ones. May your Christmas tree look better than the one from Pandemic Train. And may you receive a gift that will make you smile.
Don't let diseases get you down, and don't get off the track! 
We hope we can all find moments of rest for ourselves this Holiday season.  
[b]Merry Christmas, survivors! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/a2a94d67649275c99a7ab59b01a429103d300001.png[/img]


Unfortunately, our crew doesn’t the opportunity for a long rest, and the plague is giving them a hard time. Once the infection sneaks into your train, take care of your crew and get rid of it!
The question of how to do this will be answered by Ela as soon as you pass the first biome ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/4390d9396f4037eedf129445d5bd9d794849a0df.png[/img]

We also have an announcement for you:

[h2]Beta tests will be postponed for a few more weeks[/h2] 
You keep asking for the official beta tests launch, and we couldn't be happier with your engagement in the game's production. Your dedication means a lot to us! Our dedication to the project is also enormous. However, it led us to the decision that we needed to postpone the beta tests for a couple more weeks. 
The reason is simple: after some internal and external testing, we've decided that we want to add more features and mechanics. They will improve gameplay even more and make it more interesting, challenging, and forgiving at the same time. As a result, we want to give you a game that will satisfy both: people who grew up with rogue likes and those who are not much familiar with the genre yet. We also want to have a complete set of localizations for the game. We're finishing up work on the English original localization kit, and then we would probably need another month to have all these texts translated. 
Therefore, we've decided to move beta tests from December 2022 to Q1 2023 so the lucky 100 people who are invited to test the game can share their feedback on all the features and let us know which of those work well, and which should be changed or maybe even deleted to improve your experience. As you surely understand, it's in the best interest of the game and it's players to have all the features tested first and check what works well, and what doesn't before Pandemic Train hits the market. So, if you haven't signed up for the beta tests yet, [url=https://forms.gle/MEZTMHbDvf8Tjygr5]<click here>[/url] and use our Google Form. We will pick 100 people to participate in beta tests happening in Q1 2023, and we'll let you know here when you should check if you've got the invitation.

So feel free to add the game to your wish list to keep up to date!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1379600/Pandemic_Train/

Until the next one!

Now you can gain more space in your train to place more production stations and explore what they have to offer! If you have never built a bar for your crew or a dairy, this may be the perfect time to make up for it!

notes.title: Let's talk Pandemic Train: Codex
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome survivors![/h1]

Today is one of devlog Thursdays with more news on [b]Pandemic Train![/b] 

We want to show you a part of the pause menu in our game. You're probably wondering what may be so interesting about a pause menu. Well, let us tell you a bit about it, then!

When you're playing a game, and you want to learn more about a particular thing or mechanic, you don't want your character to be exposed to attacks while you're trying to gain knowledge, do you?

For this purpose we created a[b] codex [/b]which is located in the pause menu. You click ESC and all the needed information is available to you!
But what can you actually find out there? 
Here we have several tabs in the codex, so let's start one by one:

[b]Characters[/b]
- Here you will find all the leaders you have already met during the game. You can learn all about them here. The total amount of HP, what weapons are used by a given leader, what he can do that others can't, what module you get with him at the start, and even his biography!
However, that's not all, you will also find information about the enemies you have already met! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/e686bb905bc29dcce18b76d445ece913f298de48.jpg[/img]

[b]Items[/b]
- List of all discovered items and information about them. They are divided into 4 categories:
1. components – craft items, basic raw materials, 
2. usable – consumable items, e.g., plague vial, vaccine, water, food, 
3. weapons – here we see the strengths and weaknesses of leaders' weapons
4. special items – items to be found in the world, which can be assigned to leaders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/3554877836d961d7171e1c5a398bb8499f2f3589.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/06a251c3a4a2e8753ee98c27170ee8223e3129ef.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/0b8a850ec306b331b9e40b5523d7191554c60da2.jpg[/img]

[b]HQ[/b]
-  Here you will be able to look into your progress at the headquarters. Information about the bonuses you already have and those you will get after upgrading HQ is located here.

[b]Modules[/b]
- Information on their price, what can be produced with them, and which skill will be improved during the work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/8951293faaa8b657710b1f25aeaaeeb5ecc98e14.jpg[/img]

As you can see for yourself, pause menu grants you with a vast amount of knowledge!
However, it does not end there. Apart from the codex, we also have tabs with a map, quests, and a tutorial where you can learn even more!

The question remains… Do you still think that nothing interesting can be said about the pause menu?

and  
add Pandemic Train to your wishlist, so you don't miss a release which will be in Q1 2023!

Join us on our social media!
~ Pandemic Train team

notes.title: Pandemic Train: Steam Playtests sign-ups, PGA 2022 and a new perspective
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome![/h1]
[h2]Today, we have only good news for you! [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/647a75802ebc0f529ae07e49667544d41700110a.png[/img]

[h3][b]Steam Playtests[/b][/h3]

Starting today, you can sign up for Steam playtests for Pandemic Train. The number of places is limited, so don't waste your time and sign up now! 
Don't let this train leave without you!

[h3][b]PGA - Poznań Game Arena 2022[/b][/h3]

We also remind you that you will be able to meet us at the PGA next week, where you will also be able to test Pandemic Train. PGA - Poznań Game Arena - is an annual gaming event in Poznań, Poland. It gathers many gamers, publishers and press representatives, all connected by their passion in gaming. This year, you’ll be able to find us there in Pavilion 7th. 
We’ll be awaiting your arrival!

We would be grateful if you find some time to fill out a quick survey about your gameplay after you're done playing. Every answer gives us much-needed feedback.


[h3][b]Better travel experience[/b][/h3]

For some time, we have been testing a solution to the problem that you have been reporting. 
“Drum roll please…”

[b]A view of the train during travel! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/c79fcd9a9ac65cb799662863181a03226ed80a0c.png[/img]

The new view setting minimizes the negative sensation of moving between cars, but also makes us closer to our crew that we manage. We, as well as our testers, are pleased with this change and look forward to your feedback. 

Let us know what you think on our Discord Server, and don't forget to add Pandemic Train to your wishlist. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1379600/Pandemic_Train/

See you at the PGA!

notes.content:
[h3]Hello survivors![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/3f3d368709a318a69d07ce7c815bbb8f48f5aa34.png[/img]

Yes, we love Steam festivals, don't you? We're glad that Pandemic Train can take part in one of them again.

For this reason, the [b]Pandemic Train demo[/b] got a downloadable update now. In there, you will find:

[b]- more translations[/b]
With the update, translations in the following languages are added:
Russian
Spanish
German
Polish
French

[b]- hunger and thirst[/b]
At the end of each journey, your crewmembers will lose some of their HP if there is food or water shortage.

[b]- more bugs fixed[/b]

Download, play, and don't forget to fill in the survey at the end of the demo.
Your feedback means a lot to us!

And remember, we'd love to see your gameplays! You can send us the link on the official Discord server or in a message on Facebook or Twitter ;)

notes.title: NEW demo is here! Pandemic Train invites you aboard
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Survivors! [/h2]

Today is the day!
[b]Our NEW Demo is now available for everyone![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/a0b262897ea9e985926804e463e6f4102605a5cb.png[/img]

We have a new beginning of our pandemic train's story for you to try out.

[h2]What can you expect in the new Demo? [/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]UI visual improvements[/b]
Our graphic design has undergone a transformation to better reflect the nature of the game
[*] [b]Sound improvements[/b]
We have introduced sets full of new sounds. Among others, footsteps on a train, various sounds of gunfire or explosions
[*] [b]Brand new tutorial and tips[/b]
The tutorial has been completely re-designed from scratch in order to provide as much knowledge as possible 
[*] [b]A morgue car[/b]
The place you have been waiting for, we hope you will take good care of the bodies
[*] [b]Headquarters[/b]
You will pay a visit to the organization's headquarters where you will meet the command and be able to tour the place 
[*] [b]New locations[/b]
You will get to know our 2 new locations prepared as part of the prologue
[*] [b]Action points[/b]
This is the points system we introduced you to in dev log 31. Each character has its own action points for each run, the ones you don't use - are lost.
[*] You will also meet [b]one of the 4 characters that weren't introduced in the first demo[/b]!
[/list]

At the end of the demo, you'll find a[b] link to a short survey[/b]. Your feedback is very important to us, so please, [b]play as much as you want, and share your opinion on the game with us[/b].

Visit us on [url=https://discord.gg/NZRSqwjWSZ]our Discord server[/url] and [b]add Pandemic Train to your wishlist.[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1379600/Pandemic_Train/

Before we tell you to drop everything and play the demo, let us give you something to motivate you on a daily basis... 
[b]Be like a train: go in the sun, go in the rain, go in the storm and in the hurricane! Go into the light, go into the dark, go like a train that fears nothing and always stays on its track.[/b]

[h2]Stay on your track, Survivors!
Pandemic Train team[/h2]
